subject: english
stem: Ben is assigned to Team B. What plan meets both the schedule and location rule?
options: Meet at Dock at 09:00 in sandals.
Buy six waste bags instead of reporting.
Meet at West Bank at 09:00 and wear boots.
Meet at East Bank at 08:10 without boots.

optionRationales.reason: Meet at Dock at 09:00 in sandals.：時間地點跨列且不合 boots。
Buy six waste bags instead of reporting.：圖例數量不是個人任務。
Meet at West Bank at 09:00 and wear boots.：Team B 時刻表指向 09:00 West Bank，附註要求 boots。
Meet at East Bank at 08:10 without boots.：這是 Team A 且少用品。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 Meet at West Bank at 09:00 and wear boots.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Meet at West Bank at 09:00 and wear boots. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
